title: This Animal Survived Outer Space 🐻 #shorts
description: Tardigrades, or water bears, can survive freezing, radiation and even the vacuum of space by shutting down into a 'tun' state.

scenes.text: This tiny animal survived the vacuum of outer space.
It's a tardigrade, also called a water bear, usually less than half a millimeter long.
When its world dries up, it pulls in its legs, loses almost all its water, and shuts down into a state called a tun.
Like that, it can survive cold close to absolute zero, and radiation that would kill a human many times over.
In 2007, scientists sent tardigrades into orbit, open to space. Some came back alive, and later had babies.
Follow for more animals that refuse to die.
